title: Mobile Navigation
summary: Mobile navigation must expose location, destinations and backtracking without consuming the task area; use bottom nav for 3–5 high-frequency destinations only.

MUST.text: Keep current location visible and provide consistent access to top-level destinations.

SHOULD.text: Use bottom nav for 3–5 high-frequency destinations only.
Prefer labeled icons and persistent placement for primary destinations.

AVOID.text: Do not hide sections behind unlabeled icons or rely on browser Back alone.
Do not exceed 5 bottom-nav destinations; overflow into a menu.

EXAMPLE.good: "Four labeled destinations (Home, Search, Saved, Profile) in bottom nav; current tab marked."
EXAMPLE.bad: "Six unlabeled icons in bottom nav plus browser Back only."

FAILURE_MODES: Unlabeled icons reduce discoverability and recognition.
More than 5 destinations shrink targets and hide options.
Hidden navigation makes wayfinding and backtracking fail.
Relying on browser Back loses input and context.

sources.title: NN/g Basic Patterns for Mobile Navigation
